name: country
label: Country
help: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), such as us, gb or de. The API uses us when this is empty.

name: language
label: Language
help: Interface language code, such as en, de or pt-br. The API uses en when this is empty.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of suggestions to return. The module makes a single request; Google returns up to about 15 suggestions.
